Container.Name: tcpraid
Container.Overview: tcpraid carries one TCP connection over several TCP connections at once and puts it back together in order at the other end, for software that opens a single stream: ZFS replication, rsync, database replication. Two nodes are paired once; forwarding rules are then made in the web interface.

Config.Name: Web interface and API
Config.Description: Web interface and local API of the node. Plain HTTP: use it on a network you trust.

Config.Name: Other nodes
Config.Description: Other nodes connect here. The node that is reachable from the other one needs this port open to it.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Identity key, peers and rules of the node. Keep it, back it up like a private key, do not share it between two nodes.

Config.Name: Web interface password
Config.Description: Password of the web interface. Left empty, the node makes one at its first start and prints it once in its log.
